statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-35469 affects the spdystream library used for Kubernetes exec and port-forward operations. The aws-node-termination-handler is expected to only use standard Kubernetes REST API calls to cordon and drain nodes, and is not expected to perform exec or port-forward operations. A formal code audit is pending to confirm the vulnerable code path is never reached.
